This project builds the files with Lean 4.34.1 and Mathlib d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612.
Files changed for that toolchain, or to avoid declaring names that the Riesz library already
declares, are listed in PATCHES.txt; all other files are identical to the manifest.

Used results: `E8Leech.e8KernelNonneg` and the certificate family `E8Leech.e8CertFamily`
(`GaussianSchwartzCertificate e8Set α f` for `α > 0`, `α ≠ π`).

FC coefficient bridge (2026-10-17)
  Riesz/FCLeechMinimum24.lean specializes the existing
  SpherePacking/Dim24/LeechLattice/Norm.lean norm-spectrum proof from the same
  local E8Leach port. The source is covered by the retained Sphere-Packing-Lean
  Apache-2.0 attribution and licences. Imports, the namespace, matrix names and
  lattice aliases were adapted to the existing Riesz Leech lattice; the resulting
  proof establishes minimum norm 2, used to identify its first theta coefficients.
  Original source SHA-256: f73f05e494d6c4ec7f65b1aa317199005a5551fd5c67c911b0067438be5d317d
